original_test_intent: Validate OAM_4 power consumption is credible and consistently shown by controller, host and Web interfaces.
original_method: Map equivalent OAM_4 power channels, collect synchronized readings under a defined operating state, retain sensor resolution/accuracy and averaging metadata, normalize watts and compare ranges and deltas using approved uncertainty.
manual_activity: Power owner approves OAM_4 channel boundaries, measurement uncertainty and tolerance and owns the result.
required_inputs: OAM_4 identity and equivalent power-channel map
Sensor boundary, resolution, accuracy and averaging window
Approved operating state and sampling interval
Secure tools, credentials and Web access
safety_requirements: Use read-only queries and no unapproved load
Stop on stale, invalid, unmatched or out-of-range data
agent_execution_scope: Collect all required OAM_4 power surfaces
Record state, timing and measurement metadata
Normalize comparable channels and calculate approved uncertainty-aware deltas
Report without changing limits or verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The resource is relevant but an insecure Redfish-only scalar cannot satisfy the source or account for measurement precision.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely sample mapped OAM_4 power across Redfish/IPMI/ROCm/Web in one operating window and compare like domains using approved accuracy and timing tolerance.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: OAM_4, three named tools, Web parity and 5/5-minute scope are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Attach boundary, resolution, stated accuracy, averaging interval and sample time to every raw reading before normalized comparison.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Avoids false failures caused by display resolution or sensor accuracy differences.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No external calibration or stress power limit is claimed.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Agreement inside combined uncertainty supports consistency, not absolute metrology accuracy.

project_override_considerations: Engineering defines the OAM_4 channel accuracy and acceptable combined uncertainty; the agent cannot infer it from displayed decimals.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently requests OAM_4 cross-source power parity; DeepSeek is partial rather than conflicting.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Mappings, uncertainty rules and access are supplyable prerequisites.

review_improvement: Adds measurement uncertainty to prevent OAM_4 readings with different precision from being judged by exact equality.
independent_technical_reasoning: A BMC sensor may resolve one watt while ROCm reports finer decimals that exceed the underlying hardware accuracy, and Web can round again. Exact equality is therefore neither necessary nor sufficient. OAM_4 parity needs compatible boundaries plus combined accuracy, resolution and sampling-window tolerance while preserving raw values for audit.
